skill.summary: Fully offline, CUDA-accelerated local voice assistant pipeline for NVIDIA Jetson. Wake word (openWakeWord) → real-time VAD → whisper.cpp GPU STT → LLM → Pipe...

latestVersion.changelog: v1.1.0: Add setup.sh one-command installer (embeds systemd services inline). Fix manage.sh hardcoded devices — now uses VOICE_MIC/VOICE_SPEAKER env vars. Remove unused json import. Fix fragile test-tts heredoc. Remove cmake from runtime requires. Clean up SKILL.md: quick start section, fixed file structure, removed missing systemd/ dir reference.
